title: wall-clock access through the otherwise universal Date global still requires a capability
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals': 'Facilities truly present in every supported JavaScript environment MAY be unconditional globals. Host-sensitive operations such as clock and random access MUST still use capabilities.' docs/DECISIONS.md repeats it (Locked). Date is universal; Date.now() is host-sensitive, which is exactly the distinction this case pins — 20-host-globals/universal-globals-stay-available pins the other side.
